compiled_state.title: [merge-to-main-pr.sh]: Requires MERGE_STRATEGY env var but config already specifies it -> Hidden dispatcher coupling
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh line 57 has a hard assertion:

    : "${MERGE_STRATEGY:?MERGE_STRATEGY must be set (expected: pr)}"

This requires MERGE_STRATEGY to be set externally as an env var. The script does NOT read the value from .claude/dso-config.conf (which already has merge.strategy=pr) or from dso.workflow=ci-pr.

The coupling is to merge-to-main.sh (the dispatcher), which reads the config and sets MERGE_STRATEGY before calling merge-to-main-pr.sh. Concretely, merge-to-main.sh lines 41-43:

    if [[ "$DSO_WORKFLOW" == "ci-pr" ]]; then
        MERGE_STRATEGY="pr"
    else
        MERGE_STRATEGY="direct"
    fi

## Why this is a bug

1. Single source of truth violation: the config holds the strategy, but the implementation script ignores it and re-derives from an env var that may not be set.

2. Hidden dispatcher contract: any caller that uses merge-to-main-pr.sh directly (e.g., redistribute-session-commits.sh's PUBLISH phase) fails with a cryptic 'MERGE_STRATEGY must be set' error. The caller may not realize the strategy is already correctly set in config.

3. Discovered concretely when redistribute-session-commits.sh called merge-to-main-pr.sh in background-parallel for 8 redistributed story PRs — all 8 failed with this error despite the project's config having merge.strategy=pr (and dso.workflow=ci-pr).

## Suggested fix

Option A (preferred): merge-to-main-pr.sh reads the config itself.

    MERGE_STRATEGY="${MERGE_STRATEGY:-}"
    if [[ -z "$MERGE_STRATEGY" ]]; then
        _workflow=$(bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || true)
        if [[ "$_workflow" == "ci-pr" ]]; then
            MERGE_STRATEGY="pr"
        else
            MERGE_STRATEGY="direct"
        fi
    fi

Option B: change the assertion to a fail-safe default (preferred=pr when called for PR-mode, easily configurable via env). Document the dispatcher-only contract in the script header.

## Workaround in current use

Callers other than merge-to-main.sh (e.g., redistribute-session-commits.sh PUBLISH phase, or any direct user invocation) must set MERGE_STRATEGY=pr before invocation. The redistribute tool's PUBLISH was reaching this code via background-parallel calls and silently failing — the workaround is to call gh pr create directly (bypassing the full pipeline), which is what I'm doing for PR #140's redistribute.

## Related

- Discovered while redistributing PR #140
- Companion to bug cf84-9c07-00f8-4ad6 (SPLIT phase) and the merged 85f3-/660e-/cd29- fixes
